description: the Mitsubishi CNC simulator that mirrors the real machine's screen

single_block.note: single block toggle — you have to see both off and on to tell which state it is in

emergency_stop.note: emergency stop. confirm required. Releasing it may need a person at the machine

mdi_g.note: MDI keypad: G. 'types' is the legend printed on the key

mdi_f.note: two legends on one key: F, and E above it. 'shift_types' is what the shift key reaches

mdi_shift.note: reaches the second legend on the keypad

shift.note: one-shot on this panel: it reaches the second legend for one key, then falls back. A latching panel would say "toggle" — the two are not interchangeable and the wrong one types a different string with no error
